claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the oil softens and tames rough, wiry beards, with several noting a noticeable improvement in softness.
Many reviewers praise the large 4 oz bottle and good value compared to smaller, pricier brands.
The scent is commonly described as pleasant, though opinions on the tea tree/peppermint fragrance vary, with some expecting more tea tree.
The dropper-style dispenser that lets you shake out a few drops without spilling is mentioned as a convenient feature.
Several reviewers bought it for a husband or boyfriend and report both partners are happy with the results.
